meta.name: Mermaid Magic
meta.description: To save her kingdom, a determined young mermaid princess and her friends must join forces with the creatures that scare them the most — humans.

videos.title: The Pearls of Neptune
videos.overview: When the pearls powering Mertropia start to fade, Princess Merlinda must break the rules and swim beyond her mermaid home to save her father's life force.

videos.title: Pirates' Cove
videos.overview: Nerissa and Sasha look for Merlinda on land. But with her communication bracelet broken, the princess will have to trust her new human friends.

videos.title: Dark Secrets Beneath the School
videos.overview: Celia and Tyler help Merlinda, Nerissa and Sasha adjust to their new school above the surface and try to find answers about their missing map.

videos.title: The Guardian of the Pearls
videos.overview: A whale rescue leads Merlinda and her friends further on their quest to find more pearls — but danger is waiting below the surface.

videos.title: The Haunted Ride
videos.overview: A day at the amusement park proves relaxing — and perilous — when the gang's greatest threat makes an appearance. Alex sets out on his own mission.

videos.title: Danger at Marine Rescue Center
videos.overview: While Merlinda, Nerissa and Sasha use their powers to help Tyler and Celia save the rescue center, Barbarossa and Tempesta concoct a plan of their own.

videos.title: A Volcanic Adventure
videos.overview: The group continues their search for the missing pearls inside a dormant volcano. But Barbarossa is waiting in the shadows to disrupt their plans.

videos.title: Return to Mertropia
videos.overview: As Merlinda, Nerissa, Sasha and Alex make their way back to Mertropia, they discover that an unwelcome force has entered through the portal.

videos.title: A Test for Merlinda
videos.overview: An old foe becomes a friend as Merlinda returns to Pirate Cove to try and save Nerissa, Alex and the pearls. Fred learns the truth about his father.

videos.title: The Power of the Pearls
videos.overview: With a newfound confidence, Merlinda is ready to defeat Barbarossa once and for all. Will she be able to save her friends — and Mertropia?

videos.title: Coming of Age
videos.overview: Merlinda’s coming-of-age celebration is disrupted when an ancient force tests her courage and a dangerous enemy threatens all of Mertropia.

videos.title: A Fish Out of Water
videos.overview: Back in Morton Bay, the mermaids help Celia through a surprising change - until an old enemy turns an ordinary school day into a dangerous showdown.

videos.title: The Morton Bay Regatta
videos.overview: Merlinda and her friends enter the Morton Bay Regatta, racing above and below the waves toward a magical secret with the power to restore Mertropia.

videos.title: Waiting Game
videos.overview: As the search for Jelly goes on, a new lead brings Merlinda and her friends closer to the Sea Witch, only to land them in a dangerous trap.

videos.title: Vault of the Deep
videos.overview: The Sea Witch pulls Merlinda into an ancient vault beneath the waves. As her friends race to help, Merlinda searches the darkness for a way out.
